note: #8359 batch 38. Still-unreached writers whose answer is a seeded row, a caller-supplied id or a fixed literal, never a new generated id. Review of #9437 changed the neighbour targets: every "@" argument now names an existing row of the neighbour (batch38NeighbourFor), never null, and the run fails on a null or missing one (the "batch 38 neighbour targets" phase). Member-owned targets (b38__grant, b38__accommodation, b38__checklist, b38__pair) are the neighbour member's own rows in every pair, and b38__question is the neighbour member's current-week question in the organization and chapter pairs. Chapter-level targets (b38__claim, b38__handshake, b38__document) are the neighbour chapter's rows in those two pairs. The unit pair shares the chapter, so it names the chapter's own claim, handshake, document and weekly question (the weekly question pool is the chapter's; a unit-two question changes the chapter's question set). close_chapter_handshake and share_chapter_handshake_document now use b38__handshake and b38__document (were b30__handshake and b30__document); promote_weekly_question uses b38__question (was b36__question, which neighbours lack). The "batch 38 foreign row state" phase calls every writer as every persona of each pair, with own and neighbour arguments while the neighbour exists, and asserts that no neighbour row it could touch changes (grants, claims, requests, checklists, mentorship pairs, notes and goals, HR contacts, push subscriptions, weekly questions and promotions, support events, the handshake and its documents and events, the document, the neighbour organization's template copy, HR directory, settings and configuration audit).

add_member_mentorship_note(p_pair_id uui.reason: #8359 batch 38: the seeded mentorship pair (mentor the coordinator, mentee the unit member). The note id is the fixed idempotency key and its time is the transaction's, so the answer is the same on every call. The mentor, the mentee and organization staff get past the pair check.

close_chapter_handshake(p_handshake_id u.reason: #8359 batch 38: the fresh chapter's active batch 30 handshake (b38__handshake), closed by a chapter steward with a fixed idempotency key. The answer is that handshake row with status closed. The neighbour variant names the neighbour chapter's own active handshake (the chapter's own in the unit pair).

deactivate_form_template(p_key text).reason: #8359 batch 38: the fresh organization's own copy of a test template (no shared default has this key), so an administrator's call takes the update branch and answers the key with active false. No shared default row and no other organization's version is read or written.

fulfill_reward(p_grant_id uuid, p_carrie.reason: #8359 batch 38: the member's granted shipped-kind reward with a shipping address on file. Organization staff mark it shipped with fixed carrier and tracking; the answer is the grant id, the new status and the evidence given.

promote_weekly_question(p_question_id uu.reason: #8359 batch 38: the member's current-week submitted question (b38__question) and the member's unused priority-slot reward grant. The promotion row is keyed by the question, so the answer is the question id with promoted true. The neighbour variant names the neighbour member's own current-week question.

reactivate_form_template(p_key text).reason: #8359 batch 38: the fresh organization's own copy of the test template, as for deactivate. The update branch answers the key with active true.

record_member_hr_contact(p_member_user_i.reason: #8359 batch 38: the own variant records the caller's own contact (target is the caller), with the fixed idempotency key as the contact id and a fixed time, so every member gets the same answer. The neighbour variant names the neighbour's member: refused for a non-staff caller, and not found for staff when that member is outside the organization.

reject_chapter_leadership_claim(p_claim_.reason: #8359 batch 38: the member's pending leadership claim on the fresh chapter. An organization administrator rejects it; the answer is that claim with status rejected and the transaction's decision time.

reset_organization_setting(p_key text, p.reason: #8359 batch 38: a released, organization-editable switch the fresh organization never overrode, so no version is expected. An administrator's reset answers the key, its default and overridden false.

resolve_member_emergency_checklist(p_che.reason: #8359 batch 38: the member's alerted disciplinary-meeting checklist. The member or organization staff resolve it; the answer is that checklist id, status resolved and the transaction's time.

revoke_reward(p_grant_id uuid, p_reason.reason: #8359 batch 38: the member's granted reward. Organization staff revoke it; the answer is the grant id with status revoked.

save_member_mentorship_goal(p_pair_id uu.reason: #8359 batch 38: the seeded mentorship pair. With no goal id the fixed idempotency key is the goal id, and an open goal has no completion time, so the answer is the same on every call.

save_organization_hr_directory(p_name te.reason: #8359 batch 38: the organization's one HR directory row, keyed by the organization. Staff save fixed copy; the answer is the organization id, enabled and the transaction's time.

set_reward_shipping_address(p_grant_id u.reason: #8359 batch 38: the member's own granted shipped-kind reward. The member sets a fixed address; the answer is the grant id and that address.

share_chapter_handshake_document(p_hands.reason: #8359 batch 38: the fresh chapter's active documents-only batch 30 handshake and its published batch 30 document (b38__handshake, b38__document), shared by a chapter steward with a fixed idempotency key. The answer is the handshake and document ids. The neighbour variant names the neighbour chapter's own handshake and a document published in that chapter (the chapter's own rows in the unit pair).

transition_member_accommodation_request(.reason: #8359 batch 38: the member's submitted accommodation request (its sealed description seeded through the maintenance channel), moved to under review by organization staff with no staff note, so no sealed field changes. Under review has no resolution time, so the answer is the request id and the new status.

transition_member_mentorship_pair(p_pair.reason: #8359 batch 38: the seeded mentorship pair, completed by organization staff. The answer is the pair id, status completed and today's Eastern date.

upsert_push_subscription(p_endpoint text.reason: #8359 batch 38: a fixed endpoint on an accepted push host and fixed key material. Every signed-in member gets past the session and endpoint checks; the function returns nothing.

withdraw_chapter_leadership_claim(p_clai.reason: #8359 batch 38: the member's own pending leadership claim. The member withdraws it; the answer is that claim with status withdrawn and the transaction's decision time.
